dataset_name: I.1. Broad Money and its Affecting Factors
description: Money and Banking table from Bank Indonesia’s Indonesian Economic and Financial Statistics (SEKI) showing broad money (M2) and components, and factors affecting broad money. Includes M2, M1, currency outside commercial banks and rural banks, rupiah demand deposits, quasi money, and (in later periods) breakdowns such as time deposits (rupiah and foreign currency), savings deposits (rupiah and foreign currency), foreign currency demand deposits, and securities other than shares. Also includes factors affecting broad money such as net foreign assets, net claims on central government, claims on official/state enterprises (public non-financial corporations), claims on private sectors, import guarantee deposits, and net other items. Values are shown in billions of rupiah (Rp); some periods may be marked as provisional/temporary (angka sementara, *).
time_coverage: From 1985 to present (latest available 2026-07), monthly from 1989-01
